bestOf.title: Best of Sri Lanka: Culture, Nature and Wildlife
bestOf.summary: A richly paced introduction to the island, pairing ancient cities and misty highlands with wildlife encounters and a relaxed coastal finish.

amazing.title: Amazing Sri Lanka
amazing.summary: A generous island loop designed for travellers who want heritage, local life, scenic rail country and time beside the Indian Ocean.

escape.title: Escape to Paradise
escape.summary: A compact, unhurried route with warm-water beaches, characterful stays and just enough culture between slow island mornings.

nature.title: Nature and Wildlife of Sri Lanka
nature.summary: Move from rainforest edges to open national parks on a nature-led journey shaped around responsible wildlife viewing.

classic.title: Sri Lanka Classic
classic.summary: The island essentials in one considered week: living heritage, cool highlands, a memorable train ride and warm local hosting.

adventure.title: Independent Adventure
adventure.summary: A flexible expedition for curious travellers, combining hiking, cycling, canoeing and camping with space to explore independently.

TourBestOfSriLanka.subtitle: 8 Nights / 9 Days
TourBestOfSriLanka.heroNote: A flexible round trip combining culture, wildlife, tea country, and coast.

facts.label: Tour
facts.value: Best of Sri Lanka Culture, Nature and Wild Life

sections.title: Day 01: Airport - Colombo
paragraphs: Arrival and transfer to Colombo for a first overnight stay that keeps the opening day easy and flexible.
The itinerary can be adapted to flight timing, preferred hotel class, and the pace you want for the rest of the circuit.

sections.title: Day 03: Sigiriya - Polonnaruwa
paragraphs: This cultural stretch focuses on Sri Lanka’s heritage triangle with time for ancient cities, rock fortresses, and well known archaeological sites.
Wildlife and nature are woven into the route so the holiday feels like a single, connected journey instead of disconnected stops.

sections.title: Day 05: Kandy - Nuwara Eliya
paragraphs: The trip then climbs into tea country, where cooler air, hill stations, and scenic train or road views shift the rhythm of the holiday.
Nuwara Eliya gives the tour a softer pace before the southern wildlife and beach portions begin.

sections.title: Day 07: Yala - Galle - Bentota
paragraphs: The route finishes with a blend of safari and coast, moving from the national park through the south to the beach belt.
Because the itinerary is private, the stop order and overnight points can be adjusted around your interests and travel dates.

TourBestOfSriLanka.bookingIntro: Tell us your preferred travel month and hotel category, and we can shape the full circuit around your plan.
